name: Found Footage Film
description: Films assembled largely from pre-existing footage — archives, home movies, surveillance — recontextualized by the filmmaker. Also names the horror subgenre shot as 'recovered' documentary.

name: 3D Film
description: Films projected stereoscopically so images appear to have depth, via polarized, anaglyph, or active-shutter systems. Periodic mainstream revivals since the 1950s.

name: Cuisine
description: The culinary traditions of a culture or region — ingredient systems, techniques, and flavor principles that define a foodway, from Japanese kaiseki to French haute cuisine.

name: Sushi
description: Japanese dish of vinegared rice with fish and other ingredients — nigiri, maki, sashimi-adjacent. Evolved from Edo-period street food into a global cuisine.

name: Molecular Gastronomy
description: A culinary science applying physics and chemistry to cooking — spherification, foams, gels — pioneered by Hervé This and Ferran Adrià.

name: Sous-Vide
description: Cooking vacuum-sealed food in a precisely controlled water bath for even, repeatable results. Once restaurant-only, now a home technique.

name: Cryogenics
description: The production and study of very low temperatures and the behavior of matter near absolute zero — superconductivity, superfluidity, liquefied gases.
